title: Profile-bound connected int8 across resident and layer-bundle placement
hypothesis: A homogeneous per-output int8 frozen-base profile can execute authenticated T1 adapter work through both resident conversion and direct layer-bundle construction, survive coordinator restart, and improve the fixed TinyStories holdout while every worker gradient remains exact against an int8-specific oracle and exact FP32 remains a separate fail-closed profile.

use_case.claim: Qualify local P3 memory placements and P4 numerical admission without silently widening the exact-FP32 campaign contract.

baseline.label: Exact CPU FP32 resident LoRA
baseline.description: The connected baseline loads the complete authenticated FP32 base, returns bit-exact adapter gradients, and uses v1 implicit-exact checkpoints.

primary_metric.label: Maximum connected worker-to-int8-oracle gradient relative L2
primary_metric.description: Maximum relative L2 across all resident-converted and direct-bundle int8 worker gradients in the two-step connected campaign.

repeated_validation_suite.label: Two-step connected mixed-placement int8 campaign
repeated_validation_suite.description: Run one resident-converted and one direct-layer-bundle worker per optimizer step, restart the coordinator after step 1, and retain both persistent worker models.

final_holdout_suite.label: Frozen T1 TinyStories validation
final_holdout_suite.description: Evaluate initialization and both profile-bound checkpoints on the campaign-declared 16-sequence holdout.

guardrails.label: Profile-specific canonical checkpoint parity
guardrails.description: Every connected int8 checkpoint must remain below 1e-6 relative L2 against the centralized int8 step.

guardrails.label: Held-out loss non-regression
guardrails.description: The final int8 checkpoint must not exceed initialization held-out mean loss.

guardrails.label: Profile-bound provenance and restart
guardrails.description: Assignments, v2 weight/resume identities, evaluations, releases, and campaign restart must bind int8; a restart requested as exact FP32 must fail.

guardrails.label: Exact FP32 remains separate
guardrails.description: Exact CPU FP32 accepts only bit-exact gradients and the measured int8 trajectory must not be admitted as exact FP32.

guardrails.label: Both int8 placements reuse authenticated state
guardrails.description: Resident and direct-bundle workers must each build once and transfer zero model bytes on the warm post-restart assignment.

independent_variables.label: Frozen-base placement
independent_variables.description: Complete authenticated FP32 resident load followed by quantization versus direct authenticated layer-bundle quantization.

independent_variables.label: Numerical profile
independent_variables.description: Exact CPU FP32 versus per-output symmetric int8 with FP32 dequantization and FP32 LoRA.

controlled_variables.label: Adapter training and aggregation
controlled_variables.description: Rank-4 alpha-8 QKV LoRA, complete summed FP32 adapter gradients, one total-weight normalization, one clip, and canonical coordinator AdamW.

controlled_variables.label: Frozen TinyStories artifacts
controlled_variables.description: Training and evaluation use dataset manifest 99e5642b and tokenizer 7cb0fc24.

controlled_variables.label: Two-way global steps
controlled_variables.description: Each of two authenticated workers processes one context-256 sequence per optimizer step.
